newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures erode into close, end lower.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures erode into close, end lower.

text.p: April 2 - IMM currency futures fell more late, most ended off sharply. One fund returned to sell 1,000 to 1,500 more June yen, a bank sold 500 late. Other units quietly eroded despite losses in US stocks. Some called yen drop technical, June revisited Monday's range. Rubin remarks seen as not new, had limited effect, before Friday US data, Rubin Tokyo visit.
